summary: The project is a type of an interactive and visulaised game in which the user can see the different artefacts virtually present on their locations and can get to know more about them and learn interesting facts about them. This is beneficial as it provides students interested in Astronomy and in artefacts on extra terrestrial lands to get good quality knowledge about those artefacts in an explicit way. This way, the project intends to provide a seamless perspective of the visual perception of those artefacts. Vercel was used with JacaScript programming language to create the project. The project aims to be creative by presenting a unique way of viewing space artefacts. The factors considered included location, images, interactions and details of the artefacts and their correctness and user-friendliness.
